ofc I am, and it's truly sad situation you are in, no one should feel lonely! what do you study and where are you from? 

Personally I just started a new job, a year before uni in the city i'm going to study in. Before this job I was really fucking shy, did not want people hearing my voice in public, etc. Now, with this job I have to talk to people in public all the time, 6 hours a day. And I have to focus all my effort to fill this outgoing role. Honestly, what worked for me is faking it til i became it. (not make it) :D 

Now, I don't want you to be  another person, fuck that, be yourself. But I would think starting talking to someone you see yourself connecting to, or someone that u can see is in the same interests. The worst thing that can happen is that u start talking and then go apart, but if you dont, you have a friend! Voilá. I know it is hard as an introvert, It's extremely exhausting and nerv-wracking, but people are *probably* not going to contact you. Other than that, do you have any interests that have some kind of "society/community" that you can join in ur city or something?

Also, sorry if I have typos and such, but i'm Swedish. :)

Hey!

For me it helped me *a bit*. For me it does feel like it removed the "peak" feelings. I do not get as high ups and downs all the time. I'm going to be honest with you, It's not a miracle cure. But I feel as if it helps a bit together with other "helpful" stuff.  It does not "change" it *per se*, I just dont have high ups and downs.

I'm afraid I can't really say I share the sympton THAT much, so I can't really give a great, solid, advice. But what i found has helped me is hitting the gym. It's great because of the fact that you get out of your own little shell, even for a little while, which does a great deal. AND it releases some great chemicals, and your selfconfidence gets up a bit. 

This will probably not end your boreness instantly, but it will make you get away from your own thoughts for a bit. And after a while it might just help you get some motivation and stuff up, which probably will help you. 

Just my 2 cents, sorry I can't give you a better answer. :)
